entity.name: tus
entity.description: Tus is an open protocol for resumable uploads over HTTP enabling file uploads to recover from network interruptions. We maintain open-source implementations to easily add resumability to every application.

projects.name: tus
projects.description: Tus is an open protocol for resumable file uploads over HTTP. It enables reliable uploads that can resume after network interruptions. This project covers the protocol specification and its official implementations under github.com/tus: the tusd server (Go), tus-node-server, tus-js-client, tus-py-client, tus-java-client, tus-android-client and TUSKit (iOS and macOS).

projects.name: tusdotnet
projects.description: Tusdotnet is a feature-rich server for resumable uploads written in .NET

plans.name: Annual grant or anchor sponsorship
plans.description: For one funder, such as a grant program or an anchor sponsor, covering a year of maintainer time for tusd, tus-js-client and tus-node-server, interoperability with the IETF resumable uploads draft, and travel to IETF meetings. Partial amounts are welcome. Individuals and companies can use the monthly tiers instead.
